items.headline: OpenAI to honour shared robots.txt signal for training preferences
items.summary: OpenAI will honour a shared robots.txt signal to assist website operators in communicating their AI training preferences to participating providers.
items.why_it_matters: Website operators can use a standardised signal to specify training preferences to AI providers.

items.headline: OpenAI expands violence prevention safeguards in ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI is strengthening violence prevention in ChatGPT through expanded safeguards, earlier interventions, and a commitment to public safety reporting.
items.why_it_matters: The measures enhance safety interventions and public reporting around violent content.

items.headline: Parameter Labs details security exploit in ChatGPT HTML previews
items.summary: Parameter Labs discovered an exploit in ChatGPT's interactive HTML previews. The issue allowed untrusted code in a sandboxed frame to bypass restrictions by triggering MathLive library methods to insert custom HTML.
items.why_it_matters: Flaws in sandboxed frames can allow untrusted code to interact with parent applications.

items.headline: OpenAI introduces API credit benefit for top subscription tiers
items.summary: OpenAI has introduced API credits for subscribers on its $100, $200, and $500 monthly plans. The move matches a similar benefit recently announced by Anthropic.
items.why_it_matters: High-tier subscribers receive API credits equivalent to their monthly subscription fees.

items.headline: Privacy-focused AI assistant Ollie announces closure
items.summary: Ollie, an AI assistant designed to respect user privacy, is shutting down in a week as competition among AI assistants increases.
items.why_it_matters: Increased market competition poses challenges for niche, privacy-orientated AI tools.

items.headline: Apple Intelligence to release in China with iOS 27.3
items.summary: Apple has announced that Apple Intelligence will launch in China with iOS 27.3. Features will be available first in a beta on 4 November, followed by a full release in December.
items.why_it_matters: Apple Intelligence features will become available to users in China via the upcoming software update.
